comparison_assessments.accuracy_note: Preserves the voice of God's thunder in the whirlwind, lightning illuminating the world, and the earth's trembling and shaking, in source order. Both earth-motion verbs and direct reference to God's thunder remain intact.
comparison_assessments.creative_liberties_note: 'Rang out' supplies an audible action in the verbless opening clause. Collective 'lightning' naturally represents the Hebrew plural flashes. 'Whirlwind' selects a contextual interpretation of the rolling or wheeling term.
